name: Derrick Schofield
source:
Wandered from the Harris Kingdom, he now makes a living out of telling stories in Handel's Restaurant. He loves to listen to all kinds of stories and buys Stories from others.

He eloped with a girl when he was young and snuck into Volcano Kingdom to settle here. However, they broke up because Derrick is more used to a nomadic life.

After Derrick settled down, he learnt to make a living by telling stories, but he never met another girl who understood him better than she did.

[Edited from in-game bio]
